name: ubuntu-deep-cleaner
description: A localhost-only Ubuntu analysis and cleanup console built with Carbon Web Components.

scripts.build:server: tsup src/server/index.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/server --sourcemap --external '#node-sqlite' && install -Dm644 src/runtime/node-sqlite.mjs dist/runtime/node-sqlite.mjs
scripts.build:agent: tsup src/agent/index.ts src/agent/purge.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/agent --sourcemap
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run build:agent
